acceptance: A long recommendation is compacted to chosen work units rather than split blindly by bullets.
Deleting conversation context still permits bare Go resume from .go.
Read-only advice produces no repository mutation.

evidence.summary: Broad proof completed. End-to-end public journey: question routes advice; a 100-idea exploration persists only the compact chosen approach; source brief is deleted; intent=Go resumes solely from .go; two semantic tasks execute in the same run; every R# is verified with evidence; repo validates. First full regression found auto-evidence incorrectly closing legacy free-intent R8; repaired by restricting auto-close to execution_brief_acceptance. Final scripts/check-linux.sh: Python 3.12.13, 102 tests passed, stack .go valid, template pairing ok, no GitHub Actions. Self-reflect: durable lesson already embodied in the regression guard — evidence automation must be provenance-scoped, not applied to every tracked outcome.
